description: Golden set item format for quality and bias gates. Each file in this directory is one graded item. Files are gitignored (FERPA — real student work). Use generate_sample.py to create a non-sensitive template.

fields.text: string — the submission text the AI grades
fields.rubric_title: string — title matching a rubric in the rubric store
fields.rubric: object — full Rubric schema (same as grader.schema.Rubric). Omit if rubric_title matches a stored rubric.
fields.ai_scores: object — {criterion_id: score} from the AI (filled after grading). Omit for new items.
fields.perturbed_scores: object — optional pre-computed perturbed scores for bias gate. Omit unless pre-computed.

gate_usage.quality: quality.py loads all *.json files, computes QWK between human_scores and ai_scores totals. Need >=5 items.
gate_usage.bias: bias.py perturbs text, re-grades, measures score delta. Needs ai_scores pre-computed.

ferpa_notice: These files contain real student work. They are gitignored. Never commit. Never share. The teacher who graded them owns them.
